title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash: Two Rates for One Model, and a Legacy Id That Now Serves Another
source_used: Asian Movie Pulse (page promoting the OrcaRouter model marketplace), citing DeepSeek documentation
key_facts: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash was released on 10 Sep 2026 as the smallest model of a new architecture family
Pricing has peak and off-peak rates, peak being exactly double
Off-peak: $0.15 per million input tokens and $0.60 per million output; peak: $0.30 and $1.20
Peak windows listed by OrcaRouter: 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC on weekdays
Older model names the release supersedes are still accepted and answered by V4.1 Flash at the Flash price
Context window 1M tokens, maximum output 384K tokens
Vendor documentation read on 28 Sep 2026; the article's scheduling advice is editorial
quote_evidence: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash went out on 10 September 2026 as the smallest model in a new architecture family
the peak column holds exactly double the off-peak figure
why_it_matters_hint: Developers' bills depend on the time of day, and old model names silently point to a new model.
notes: Older news (release 10 Sep) re-dated; the page is from a marketplace with a commercial interest and rests on DeepSeek's documentation read 28 Sep.
